reader.requirement: At 85, every COMPUTE identifier-1 must be an elementary numeric or elementary numeric-edited item, and the compiler must refuse at compile time a group, an alphanumeric, alphanumeric-edited or alphabetic item, a reference-modified slice and an index data item (§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5).

edition-consulted.switches: introduction gate on format 2 (boolean COMPUTE, 2002); refused at 85

reader.edition-search: ScreenResultant reads the edition only for the diagnostic position (ctx.Edition.At); I grepped Year/DialectLevel/CobolVersion in ExpressionBinder.cs and ArithmeticBinder.cs#BindCompute and found no other read
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the receiver screen is the same at 85 and 2023. Only boolean COMPUTE (format 2) is gated
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb128 covers a PIC X receiver only. It does not cover group, edited, alphabetic, ref-mod or index receivers, numeric-edited acceptance, or several receivers

probes.expected: scaled signed, numeric-edited (ROUNDED), currency-edited, COMP and subscripted receivers accepted; 18-digit and zero values; COMPUTE I T(I) = 3 stores T(3) (multiple results in order)

probes.printed: seven COBOL1675 errors: XR (PIC X), AE (PIC XX/XX), G (group), N1(1:2) (ref-mod), IX (index), AB (PIC A), and XR as the second receiver of COMPUTE N1 XR
probes.expected: each non-numeric, non-numeric-edited identifier-1 refused at compile time

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the boolean operators ... requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85), plus COBOL0900 for USAGE BIT
error COBOL0001: cannot parse construct near 'EQUAL' (same at --std 2023)
probes.expected: 1985 prints only '='; EQUAL is not in any edition's COMPUTE format

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.8.3 SR1  (║6.8.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5  (5.14.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: Every refusal is correct. A wording nit at every edition: ScreenResultant prints pic.Category, not AnalyzedCategory, so an alphanumeric-edited (XX/XX) or alphabetic (PIC A) receiver is reported as 'of category Alphanumeric', and the message cites §2023 at --std 85. This affects diagnosis text only.

refuter.evidence: r2a.cob (runs/r2a-001, compile-only): COMPUTE RG = 1 with 66 RG RENAMES N1 THRU N2 refused (COBOL1675, a group-like rename); COMPUTE TE = 1 on an unsubscripted OCCURS element refused (COBOL2270); COMPUTE C-ON = 1 on a condition-name refused (COBOL1639). r2b.cob (runs/r2b-002): accepted and correct: 66 R1 RENAMES N2 (an elementary rename) gets 077; a numeric REDEFINES of PIC X(4) gets 1234; PIC 9PP and VPP9 scaled receivers; SIGN LEADING SEPARATE -012; PIC 9(3) BLANK WHEN ZERO (numeric edited at 85) as a second receiver gets 012 and spaces for 0; 999.99DB gets 001.50DB and **9.9 gets **1.5. Side observation outside this rule: DISPLAY of PIC 9PP prints 400 and of VPP9 prints .000 (the P positions are printed), which is a DISPLAY-rule question, not a COMPUTE receiver one. cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.8.3 SR1  (║6.8.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1.
